berita.judul: Bond market anxiety is growing over AI capex budgets

berita.judul_id: Kecemasan pasar obligasi meningkat terhadap anggaran belanja modal AI
berita.ringkasan_id: Google, Amazon dan Meta melihat selisih kredit melebar karena investor berpendapatan tetap menuntut lebih banyak imbalan pada perusahaan yang mereka beri pinjaman.

berita.judul: Trump considers ‘massive attack’ on Iran; Pakistan reportedly seeks to restart stalled peace talks
berita.ringkasan: The president told Axios he was considering an operation "bigger than ever before" before Reuters reported Pakistan is seeking to restart peace talks.

berita.judul: Oil shipments are under attack on multiple fronts as fighting escalates in Red Sea, Hormuz and Black Sea

berita.judul: Oil falls on report Pakistan is pushing for new U.S.-Iran talks with China's backing

berita.judul_id: Harga minyak turun karena laporan bahwa Pakistan mendorong perundingan baru antara AS-Iran dengan dukungan Tiongkok

berita.judul: Boom in tech wealth is fueling record prices for dinosaur bones, art and watches, auction houses say
berita.ringkasan: The major auction houses racked up nearly $10 billion in sales in the first half, marking one of the strongest-ever starts to the year.
berita.judul_id: Lonjakan kekayaan teknologi memicu rekor harga tulang dinosaurus, karya seni, dan jam tangan, kata rumah lelang
berita.ringkasan_id: Rumah lelang besar meraup penjualan hampir $10 miliar pada semester pertama, menandai salah satu awal tahun terkuat yang pernah ada.

berita.judul: Why bond investors are pushing up some of your interest rates
berita.ringkasan: Many types of consumer loans such as mortgages peg their interest rate to the yield on 10-year Treasury bonds, which has been moving higher.
berita.judul_id: Mengapa investor obligasi menaikkan sebagian suku bunga Anda

berita.judul: Moody's says 'unprecedented' AI spending threatens credit quality of Amazon, Meta, Alphabet and others

berita.ringkasan_id: Moody's mengatakan belanja AI memaksa bahkan perusahaan-perusahaan yang paling kaya uang di dunia untuk bergantung pada utang, penjualan saham, dan pergerakan di luar neraca.
